svg.title: Timeouts
svg.desc: Two copies of a checkout service call a shipping service whose database is locked. With no timeout, each checkout grabs a thread that waits forever until all six are stuck and new shoppers are turned away. With a 400 ms timeout, a countdown runs out, the call is cut, the thread is freed and the shopper gets a flat shipping rate.
svg.text: With no timeout every thread waits forever. With one, threads free up.
